lessons_learned.description: First draft was 3780 chars (38% of minimum). Second full rewrite reached 5690. Required 3 rounds of incremental expansion across all 12 chapters to reach 10001.
lessons_learned.root_cause: ancient_sweet source has avg_line_chars=16.7 and short_line_rate=0.639, creating ultra-short lines. Writing to match this rhythm naturally produces very low char density per chapter.
lessons_learned.fix: For sources with avg_line_chars < 18, aim for 20+ more lines per chapter to compensate for low per-line density. Budget 1200-1500 chars per non-climax beat and 1500-2000 for climax beats.

lessons_learned.description: Source short_line_rate=0.639 but candidate=0.470. A 0.17 gap exists. Rhythm still passes but indicates the expansion added longer lines.
lessons_learned.root_cause: When expanding for char count, natural tendency is to add detail/context in longer sentences rather than maintaining the source's ultra-short fragmented style.
lessons_learned.fix: When expanding, prefer adding more SHORT lines (single-clause fragments, object descriptions, brief reactions) rather than lengthening existing lines.

lessons_learned.description: One instance of '此刻' found during validation. Easily fixed by replacing with '现在'.
lessons_learned.root_cause: Natural language generation tendency toward formal temporal markers.
lessons_learned.fix: Always run AI forbidden word check before finalizing.

pipeline_recommendations: For ultra-short-line sources (avg < 18 chars), set initial writing target to 12000+ chars to allow for natural compression during editing
Add a pre-flight char estimate step: count beat budgets and verify total target is achievable before writing
The 3-round expansion pattern (full chapters -> key chapters -> scattered additions) is reliable but expensive; prefer getting closer on first draft
